build_fuse_gtest: build fused gtest.h and gtest-all.cc from gtest root directory into a single output directory
create_fused_gtest_files: create gtest/gtest.h and gtest/gtest-all.cc by scanning gtest source and resolving all includes
test_fuse_gtest_h: test the FuseGTestH function that scans gtest_root and generates gtest/gtest.h with resolved includes
refactor_fuse_gtest_all_cc: refactor the FuseGTestAllCc function to generate gtest/gtest-all.cc with all source files fused
run_fuse_gtest_cli: run the fuse_gtest_files.py CLI with optional gtest_root_dir and output_dir arguments
